# TigEats meal prep desk

The public menu is for clients. Staff talk to their agent in Slack. The agent runs in n8n.

- Menu page: /b/tigeats
- Menu JSON: /api/menu
- Who ordered: GET /api/agent/status with Authorization: Bearer <token from the staff Agent page>
- Menu updates POST a JSON trigger to the n8n webhook saved on that page. The body includes menuUrl and each client.

The staff desk is /terminal and is not part of the client menu.
